title: Homeowner-Plan Credit Schedule for Late-Billed Rental Installments
content:
**Credit rule.** A late-billed Rental Property Service Contracts monthly installment carries a homeowner-plan credit read from the landlord's Bridgewell Homeowner Service Contracts holdings.

| The landlord's Homeowner Service Contracts holding | Homeowner-plan credit |
|---|---|
| an active homeowner service contract billed annually | 0.03 |
| an active homeowner service contract billed monthly | 0.02 |
| otherwise | 0 |

**Records read.** From the Homeowner Service Contracts records: the landlord's homeowner service contract in status active and its billing frequency.

**How the rate acts.** The credit rates on a late-billed installment are added together and subtracted from one, and the installment is multiplied once by that sum.

*Hypothetical:* a landlord whose own home carries an active homeowner service contract billed monthly: 0.02. One whose homeowner contract shows expired: 0.
